## Personality

Thomas Sowerby is a quiet, small man. He is known to locals in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) as the husband of [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Sowerby is an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) who was brought to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to help [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) on his farm. His arrival caused skepticism and concern for neighboring community members like Mrs. Agatha Sowerby.
